propositions: Invariant 2 (Model parity) references provider_provenance.ran_model as a per-pass field, but the schema stores only one model id per review, not per-pass, causing the corpus-baseline refusal rule to be undefined for Pass-1 (Tier-2, frontier model).

Tier-1 (Pass-2) filtering uses corpus ran_model from the pool, while Tier-2 (Pass-1) resolves parity from the config model-class table, but the plan states a single uniform rule without documenting the per-pass split or Pass-1 exception.

Corpus rows with null or absent provider_provenance have no specified disposition in the parity-check rule; legacy rows may either crash on model comparison or silently admit rows of unknown provenance into a parity-guarded run.

The plan asserts per-pass model ids are recorded in every result, but Pass-1 sampling pool documentation shows no corpus rows carry a frontier-class ran_model, making a frontier-model filter infeasible under the stated rule.

Qualifier needed: corpus-baseline ran_model guard should apply explicitly to Pass-2 sampling, while Pass-1 parity enforcement should reference the config model-class table (resolved frontier class), not the corpus ran_model field.
